# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

This project helps people turn early research ideas into evidence-scoped, executable research plans. We welcome contributors, users, and reviewers who communicate with intellectual honesty, care for research participants and data subjects, and respect different disciplines, methods, languages, identities, and levels of experience.

Be constructive and specific. Challenge claims, evidence, workflow decisions, or implementations without attacking people. State uncertainty when evidence is incomplete. Do not pressure anyone to disclose an unpublished idea, private dataset, institutional material, or personal information.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, discrimination, threats, personal attacks, sexualized language, doxxing, retaliation, and repeated bad-faith disruption are not acceptable. Neither are fabricated citations or results; unsupported claims of novelty, publication certainty, or participant safety; or sharing confidential research material without authorization.

## Reporting and enforcement

For conduct concerns, contact the repository maintainer privately rather than opening a public issue. Include only the information needed to assess the concern; do not post sensitive evidence publicly. Reports will be handled as promptly and confidentially as practical. Maintainers may request clarification, remove content, limit participation, or take other proportionate action to protect participants and the project.
